description: Deterministic qualitative safety rules for the three AEGIS Rx hackathon research-prototype demo cases. Numeric INR, renal, dose, QTc, and monitoring values are omitted because this repository does not contain validated evidence for those parameters.

rules.evidence_text: AEGIS hackathon demo case: warfarin plus fluconazole with rising INR. No validated INR numeric threshold, warfarin dose adjustment, or INR monitoring interval is present in this repository; those parameters require validated evidence. Deterministic safety action is limited to review/hold/monitor and safer-alternative evaluation. This is not autonomous prescribing.

AEGIS hackathon demo case: enoxaparin with declining renal function. No validated eGFR/CrCl cutoff, dose, or dose-adjustment schedule for enoxaparin is present in this repository; those parameters require validated evidence. Deterministic safety action is limited to review/hold/monitor and dose-adjustment evaluation. This is not autonomous prescribing.

AEGIS hackathon demo case: duplicate ACE-inhibitor therapy. No validated ACE-inhibitor pair list, dose, or combination threshold is present in this repository; those parameters require validated evidence. Deterministic safety action is duplicate therapy review. This is not autonomous prescribing.
